description: Source code for WKExecutionContext class implementing JavaScript execution context handling in WebKit, including evaluation, property retrieval, and handle management.

classes.name: WKExecutionContext
classes.description: Implements JavaScript execution context delegate for WebKit, providing methods for evaluating scripts, retrieving properties, and managing handles.

methods.name: rawEvaluateJSON
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript expression and returns the result as JSON.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript expression and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: evaluateWithArguments
methods.description: Calls a function with arguments within the execution context.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a JavaScript object handle.
